caption: In re Congoleum Corp.
citation_line: In re Congoleum Corp., No. 23-1295 (3d Cir. Aug. 22, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: On bankruptcy appeal, Judge Arleo reversed an order reopening Congoleum’s long-closed bankruptcy and rejected the bankruptcy court’s conclusion that a plan finding insulated Bath Iron Works from environmental liabilities.
qualification_rationale: The dispute arose from decades of asbestos and environmental litigation and presented important questions about post-confirmation bankruptcy jurisdiction, reopening a closed case, interpretation of a confirmation order, notice, res judicata, and third-party releases.
appellate_posture_note: After panel rehearing, the Third Circuit reversed the district judgment in a precedential opinion and reinstated the bankruptcy court’s result, concluding that reopening was proper and that the confirmation finding bound Occidental.
decision_selection_note: ECF 25 of 2:22-cv-00423, found under the short docket form 22-cv-423: “ORDER reversing the Bankruptcy Court’s Order, and First Congoleum Bankruptcy is closed. Signed by Judge Madeline Cox Arleo on 1/31/2023.” Captioned below as Occidental Chemical Corp. v. Bath Iron Works Corp., because a bankruptcy appeal takes the parties’ names. RECAP holds no PDF of it and CourtListener carries three duplicate dockets for the number, so this stays held until a free public copy is located — GovInfo next.
